## Packaging changes (2026-09-17)

Fixed an upstream text-size concatenation bug (14220px instead of 142px) and use Arial as a local font fallback.

## Source availability

This directory contains the complete source used to serve the game, including local packaging changes. No build is required. Copy the entire directory with licenses intact.
